sources.title: Far EasTone selects Ericsson for 5G
sources.effective_period: 5G RAN deployment across Far EasTone’s low-, mid-, and high-band spectrum assets; commercial service planned for summer 2020.
sources.note: Ericsson’s announcement says it was selected as Far EasTone’s 5G RAN vendor and that the deal spans those spectrum bands.

sources.title: 遠傳電信選擇愛立信 持續強化5G網路部署
sources.effective_period: 5G network expansion and hardware updates; the announcement describes a three-year service-improvement horizon.
sources.note: The announcement describes Ericsson’s work on 5G base-station deployment and quotes Far EasTone’s president saying the company had long selected Ericsson equipment for its nationwide 5G build.

sources.title: Far EasTone and Ericsson enter three-year strategic partnership to advance AI-ready, high-performing 5G in Taiwan
sources.note: Confirms a current three-year RAN modernization partnership, but does not state what proportion of base stations Ericsson supplies.

sources.title: 遠傳電信選擇愛立信 持續強化5G網路部署
sources.effective_period: Dual-mode SA/NSA 5G core-network deployment announced in 2021.
sources.note: Identifies the dual-mode 5G Core solution and says Far EasTone commissioned Ericsson to expand NSA and add SA network capability.

sources.title: Far EasTone and Ericsson enter three-year strategic partnership to advance AI-ready, high-performing 5G in Taiwan
sources.note: Describes RAN and Core modernization and expansion of the deployed dual-mode 5G Core solution to additional sites.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches found official evidence of Ericsson’s RAN and Core supplier relationships, including a 2026–2028 agreement. No evidence located defined or quantified “main supplier,” so that qualifier remains unresolved.
The key supplier and contract announcements are published by Ericsson, the vendor; the 2021 announcement also quotes Far EasTone’s president.
No source found in this review quantified supplier shares by base-station count, RAN capacity, core-network equipment, or spending.
The claim does not specify period or market scope. Public commercial mobile-network deployments and dedicated private 5G networks should not be conflated.
